messages:
sara_fin: Flagging overdue invoice INV-2030-912 for Tideflow Inc. Amount $29,450.00  ACH returned (R03) on 2024-04-11. AP says they applied an internal credit and disputed 6% for alleged data mismatch. Soft reminder sent, no reply. Need plan: retry, card attempt, split-pay, formal notice, or immediate escalation?

billing-bot: Soft dunning email sent to billing@tideflow.ai at 2312345680. Automated ACH retry scheduled (+48h).

dina_sales: AE update: Tideflow's procurement contacted us  they claim an internal credit memo CN-447 for $1,767.00 and won't release wire until resolved. CFO said they can pay the undisputed portion today by card if we allow a 3-installment plan for the rest.

noah_ops: I can create a one-time card link and queue a second card attempt. Example ops command we use:
```
# ops: generate card pay link
/redwood billing link create --invoice INV-2030-912 --amount 29450 --method card --ttl 5d
```

sara_fin: Let's aim to get cash in bank: 1) attempt a card charge for undisputed portion (invoice minus claimed credit), 2) create 3-installment plan for remaining balance with signed addendum, 3) send formal cure notice referencing SOW 7.1 and set internal escalation timeline. Legal ok?

ashley_legal: Per SOW 7.1 we must give 21 days' written notice prior to external collections. We can send a cure notice now (cc legal). Addendum must state that disputed amounts must be documented in writing and do not permit withholding of undisputed charges. Also recommend we include a short service suspension clause for missed installment payments.

lina_csr: Drafting email to billing@tideflow.ai to attach invoice, calculated undisputed amount, card pay link, and proposed 3x installment schedule. Will cc legal. Will paste copy once sent.

jared_collections: Collections note: If they accept installments we should set a hard trigger for external collections at 30 days from invoice date for any unpaid balance. Prefer 3 installments spaced 14 days apart to keep timeline short. Also require signature on addendum before first installment clears.

noah_ops: Card link created: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/tideflow-card-231 (expires in 5 days). I calculated undisputed = $27,683.00 after their claimed credit. Created draft installment plan template.

dina_sales: I'll push their CFO to sign the addendum today; they're willing to pay first installment immediately by card if we accept plan. Sales will accept short grace if they sign.

sara_fin: Michelle (lina) send the cure notice + card link now. Addendum must include: payment schedule, late fee 8% on overdue balance, service suspension clause after missed 2 installments, and external collections trigger (30 days from invoice). Keep it tight.

lina_csr: Sent formal notice at 2312347000 to billing@tideflow.ai, cc procurement@tideflow.ai and ashley_legal@redwood.example. Subject: "Formal Notice & Payment Options: INV-2030-912 per SOW 7.1". Included invoice PDF, ledger snapshot, card link, wire instructions, and addendum draft. Notice excerpt below:
> Per SOW 7.1, customer shall cure payment within twenty-one (21) days of written notice. Failure to cure may result in late fees, service suspension, and collections. Please remit undisputed amounts immediately.

billing-bot: One-time card link used? No charge yet. Reminder scheduled in 48h.

sara_fin: Logged internal ticket FIN-TIDE-2030-912. If no payment or signed addendum by 2312347800 we'll escalate to collections for next steps. Jared, keep external collections on standby.

dina_sales: CFO replied at 2312347400: "We will sign the addendum and pay first installment by card within 24h, procurement will follow up on credit memo." Routing CFO signature link now.

jared_collections: Thx. Once first installment clears, mark invoice pending-plan and set external collections trigger for 2024-05-11. If they miss second installment without a written dispute hold, escalate immediately.

ashely_legal: (typo) Ashley: noted and will review signed addendum before acknowledging receipt. Reiterate: disputes must be itemized in writing; undisputed sums remain due.

sara_fin: Good progress. Keep updates here. If card declines, we attempt a second card attempt then pivot to wire option. :white_check_mark:
